Description
American Eagle Gold coins
are the official coin of the United States which were issued as per the Gold Bullion ACT of 1985 and were first released by the US Mint in 1986. 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle coin is one of the traded
gold bullion coins
in the world.
The 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle coin is made of 22kt gold alloy minted with gold mined exclusively from the American resources as stipulated by legislation. These coins are alloyed with silver and copper which makes them more wear-resistant coins and have a purity of 91.67% or 22k.
The 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle coin bears a face value of $10 but the gold value is much more as the purity and weight of these beautiful gold coins are guaranteed by the United States Government and backed by the United States Mint.
This quarter-ounce American Gold coin is beloved globally, and it is a great purchase for novices who are just starting to get into precious metals investing. When you order these coins from
Bullion Trading LLC
, you will be receiving the ¼ oz American Eagle Gold Coin of different minted years based on the stock available in our inventory.
Design of 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle Coin
The obverse of the 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle coin has remained the same since 1986 which features the depiction of the Lady Liberty which was designed by Saint- Gaudens.
The Lady Liberty with flowing hair striding forward on the mountaintop with rays of the sun behind her, carrying a flaming torch in her right hand to represent the enlightenment, and an olive branch, a symbol of peace on the left is depicted on the obverse of the coin. The words “Liberty” appear prominently across the top of the coin and the image of the
Capitol building
along with the mint year is displayed at the bottom.
The reverse of the 1/4 oz Gold American Eagle Gold coin features the depiction of a family of American bald eagles which was designed by Miley Busek. The design features a depiction of a male eagle with an olive branch on its claw flying toward the nest where the female eagle awaits with her hatchlings. The phrase “United States of America” is displayed across the top and the purity and weight of the gold coin can be read at the bottom. The words, “E Pluribus Unum” and, “In God We Trust” are inscribed to the left and right of the eagles.
Main Highlights of 1/4 oz American Eagle Gold Coin
Contains ¼ troy oz of .9167 fine gold.
Official bullion coin of United States.
Manufactured by the US Mint.
Bears a face value of $10 and is backed by the federal government.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
The obverse features the depiction of Lady Liberty.
The reverse features the depiction of a family of American bald eagles along with the weight and purity of the gold.
